boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named University of Delaware spaces for studying, gathering, creating, gaming, reflection, and campus events.

cards.title: Study beneath the stained glass
cards.subtitle: Trabant University Center, Room 276
cards.notes: Bring a reading assignment or laptop to this tranquil, arched room, then use its gathering setup for a low-key conversation between classes.
cards.short_summary: A stained-glass study and gathering room inside Trabant.
cards.evidence_claim: UD identifies Daugherty Hall as a tranquil study and gathering space with dramatic arched stained-glass windows.
cards.source_title: Trabant University Center | University Student Centers | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Listed in the Trabant directory as Room 276; check the student center page for current building access.

cards.title: Settle into Trabant Lounge
cards.subtitle: Trabant University Center, Room 110
cards.notes: Use the lounge’s soft seating for a study break or focused work, while allowing for the room’s possible conversion into an event venue.
cards.short_summary: A flexible lounge for relaxing, studying, lectures, and performances.
cards.evidence_claim: UD describes Trabant Lounge as a space for relaxing and studying that can transform for lectures or performances.
cards.source_title: Trabant University Center | University Student Centers | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Listed in the Trabant first-floor directory as Room 110; events may affect availability.

cards.title: Take a quiet reset in Room 223
cards.subtitle: Trabant University Center, Room 223
cards.notes: Use this dedicated room for private meditation, prayer, or reflection when you need a quiet pause during a campus day.
cards.short_summary: A daily-open room for private reflection in Trabant.
cards.evidence_claim: UD states that the Interfaith Meditation and Prayer Room in Room 223 is open daily for private meditation, prayer, and reflection.
cards.source_title: Trabant University Center | University Student Centers | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Listed on Trabant’s second floor as Room 223; intended for private meditation, prayer, and reflection.

cards.title: Look for a screening at Trabant Theater
cards.subtitle: Trabant University Center, lower level
cards.notes: Check campus programming for a film screening, guest speaker, or presentation that uses this formal theater on Trabant’s lower level.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level theater configured for screenings and presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: UD describes Trabant Theater as a formal, private lower-level space for film screenings, guest speakers, and presentations.
cards.source_title: Trabant University Center | University Student Centers | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Listed in Trabant’s lower-level directory as Room 010; attend scheduled programs or confirm room availability.

cards.title: Play or watch at the Esports Arena
cards.subtitle: Perkins Student Center, Room 113
cards.notes: Plan a campus-community gaming session or follow Blue Hen Esports activity in the arena, which includes PCs, a Switch, and streaming capability.
cards.short_summary: A Perkins gaming venue equipped for campus esports activity.
cards.evidence_claim: UD says the Esports Arena supports campus-community esports and gaming, with 38 gaming PCs, a Nintendo Switch, and streaming capabilities.
cards.source_title: Perkins Student Center | University Student Centers | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Listed in the Perkins first-floor directory as Room 113; verify current arena procedures before visiting.

cards.title: Catch campus activity in West Lounge
cards.subtitle: Perkins Student Center, Room 161
cards.notes: Check the student-center schedule for campus activities or events using this lounge, then arrive ready for its stage-and-A/V event format.
cards.short_summary: A Perkins event lounge with a built-in stage and A/V system.
cards.evidence_claim: UD states that West Lounge serves as a hub for campus activities and events and includes a built-in stage and high-quality A/V system.
cards.source_title: Perkins Student Center | University Student Centers | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Listed in the Perkins first-floor directory as Room 161; event setup may limit drop-in use.

cards.title: Use the graduate lounge for a work session
cards.subtitle: Perkins Student Center, Room 114
cards.notes: Graduate students can use the study tables and soft seating for a change of scene; bring ID because the lounge uses card-reader access.
cards.short_summary: A card-access lounge with casual and study seating for graduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: UD says the Graduate Student Lounge has soft seating and high-top study tables, with card-reader access for graduate students.
cards.source_title: Perkins Student Center | University Student Centers | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Graduate-student card-reader access is required; listed in the Perkins first-floor directory as Room 114.

cards.title: Choose a sunlit library table
cards.subtitle: Morris Library, second floor
cards.notes: Use the second-floor atrium when you want a quiet study area with natural sunlight, and consult the live seats page before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, naturally lit second-floor study area in Morris Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Morris Library’s available-seats page lists the Atrium on the second floor as a quiet space with natural sunlight.
cards.source_title: Morris Library Available Seats | University of Delaware Library, Museums and Press
cards.access_notes: The library’s live seat display lists the Atrium on the second floor; consult it for current availability.

cards.title: Read in the first-floor Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Morris Library, first floor
cards.notes: Bring reading or writing work to the first-floor Reading Room when you prefer a quiet setting, and check the library’s live seat display first.
cards.short_summary: A quiet first-floor study area in Morris Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Morris Library’s available-seats page lists the Reading Room on the first floor and identifies it as a quiet space.
cards.source_title: Morris Library Available Seats | University of Delaware Library, Museums and Press
cards.access_notes: The library’s live seat display lists the Reading Room on the first floor; check current capacity before visiting.

cards.title: Make a project in the Data and Design Commons
cards.subtitle: Morris Library, lower level
cards.notes: Use the open-access creative technology room for media software, or arrange a consultation for data, visualization, video, audio, or design work.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level library hub for research data and media production.
cards.evidence_claim: UD says the Research Data and Design Commons includes data visualization, editing, and sound spaces; its Creative Technology Instruction Room is open access.
cards.source_title: Research Data and Design Commons | UD MakerNetwork | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Located in Morris Library’s lower level. The official page lists current service hours and distinguishes the open-access instruction room.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten free, under-21-safe ways to spend time around UD through campus galleries, gardens, library spaces, and a walking tour.

cards.title: Browse Mechanical Hall Gallery
cards.subtitle: University Museums, Newark campus
cards.notes: Meet at Mechanical Hall and take a slow lap through the rotating exhibition; compare one artwork each before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A free rotating-exhibition stop in historic Mechanical Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: University Museums states that its exhibitions, galleries, and programs are free and open to everyone.
cards.source_title: About University Museums
cards.access_notes: Museum galleries operate Tuesday–Friday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m. during fall and spring semesters and close during summer and academic breaks.

cards.title: Look for a favorite specimen
cards.subtitle: Penny Hall, University Museums
cards.notes: Use the cases in Penny Hall for a quick visual scavenger hunt: pick a color, texture, or crystal form and compare finds.
cards.short_summary: See mineral specimens on view in Penny Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: University Museums states that its exhibitions, galleries, and programs are free and open to everyone; its Mineralogical Museum is in Penny Hall.
cards.source_title: About University Museums
cards.access_notes: Museum galleries operate Tuesday–Friday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m. during fall and spring semesters and close during summer and academic breaks.

cards.title: See what is on view at Old College
cards.subtitle: Old College, University Museums
cards.notes: Start at the gallery, read the exhibition introduction, then each choose one piece to discuss on the walk back across campus.
cards.short_summary: A rotating-exhibition gallery in Old College.
cards.evidence_claim: University Museums states that its exhibitions, galleries, and programs are free and open to everyone; Old College Gallery is one of its gallery spaces.
cards.source_title: About University Museums
cards.access_notes: Museum galleries operate Tuesday–Friday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m. during fall and spring semesters and close during summer and academic breaks.

cards.title: Walk the Special Collections Gallery
cards.subtitle: Morris Library, University of Delaware
cards.notes: Enter through the gallery on Morris Library’s second floor and pause at the display labels before continuing to the reception area.
cards.short_summary: A gallery for rotating rare-materials exhibitions in Morris Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UD Library identifies the Special Collections Gallery in Morris Library as one of four spaces with rotating exhibitions that are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: About the University of Delaware Library, Museums and Press
cards.access_notes: The gallery is in Morris Library; visitors age 16 or older who are not UD affiliates must show photo ID and sign in at the Welcome Desk.

cards.title: Settle in with library resources
cards.subtitle: The Green, University of Delaware
cards.notes: Bring a friend, choose a table, and browse books, periodicals, government documents, or DELCAT Discovery together inside the building.
cards.short_summary: A campus library open for in-building use.
cards.evidence_claim: UD Library says anyone may enter Morris Library and use its books, periodicals, government documents, and DELCAT Discovery resources in the building.
cards.source_title: Visiting Information
cards.access_notes: UD students use a valid ONEcard. Non-UD visitors age 16+ show photo ID and sign in at the Welcome Desk; borrowing requires a separate card.

cards.title: Plan a rare-materials research visit
cards.subtitle: Second floor of Morris Library
cards.notes: Choose a catalog item together, send an Ask Special Collections request, and book a visit to examine the requested material in person.
cards.short_summary: A request-ahead option for hands-on archival research.
cards.evidence_claim: UD Special Collections directs visitors to identify materials in its catalog or finding aids and request an in-person visit; it is located on Morris Library’s second floor.
cards.source_title: Visitor Information – Special Collections
cards.access_notes: Request materials before visiting through the Ask Special Collections form or AskSpec@udel.libanswers.com; enter through the exhibition gallery.

cards.title: Take a garden stroll
cards.subtitle: Townsend Hall grounds, Newark
cards.notes: Walk the garden paths at an unhurried pace, then stop somewhere along the route to compare what is blooming or changing seasonally.
cards.short_summary: A 15-acre public garden for free self-guided walks.
cards.evidence_claim: UD states that the 15-acre Botanic Gardens is open to the public free of charge from dawn to dusk daily.
cards.source_title: Fall wildflower season is in full force in Delaware
cards.access_notes: Open from dawn to dusk daily for self-guided visits. The university notes that visitor parking may carry a separate fee.

cards.title: Pause in the Clark Garden
cards.subtitle: University of Delaware Botanic Gardens
cards.notes: Use this named garden area as a low-key meet-up point, then make a loop through the surrounding Botanic Gardens paths together.
cards.short_summary: A named garden within the free UD Botanic Gardens.
cards.evidence_claim: UD identifies the Clark Garden as part of the University of Delaware Botanic Gardens, which is open to the public free of charge.
cards.source_title: Fall wildflower season is in full force in Delaware
cards.access_notes: The Botanic Gardens are open dawn to dusk daily for free self-guided visits; visitor parking may carry a separate fee.

cards.title: Follow the Lepidoptera Trail
cards.subtitle: University of Delaware Botanic Gardens
cards.notes: Walk the interpretive trail with a friend and look for the native plants that support butterflies, moths, and skippers across life stages.
cards.short_summary: An interpretive native-plant trail in the Botanic Gardens.
cards.evidence_claim: UD describes the Lepidoptera Trail in the Botanic Gardens as an interpretive trail featuring native plants that provide food for butterflies, moths, and skippers.
cards.source_title: This is prime time for wildflower lovers
cards.access_notes: The Botanic Gardens are open dawn to dusk daily for free self-guided tours; visitor parking may carry a separate fee.

cards.entity_name: University of Delaware Self-Guided Campus Tour
cards.title: Walk the self-guided campus route
cards.subtitle: University of Delaware Newark campus
cards.notes: Register for the walking-tour map, invite a friend, and use the route as a relaxed way to see campus outdoors between stops.
cards.short_summary: A registration-based walking tour of the Newark campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UD Admissions invites visitors to explore campus through a self-guided tour and provides a walking-tour map after registration.
cards.source_title: University of Delaware Self-Guided Campus Tours
cards.access_notes: Arrive any time during the day after registering. The self-guided tour does not include access to campus buildings.

cards.title: Newark Arts Alliance
cards.subtitle: Louviers Drive corridor — 207 Louviers Dr
cards.notes: Look for gallery exhibits, classes, or public arts programming at this nearby nonprofit; its official site posts its Newark address and operating hours.
cards.short_summary: A local arts nonprofit with exhibitions, classes, and community programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Newark Arts Alliance lists its location at 207 Louviers Drive and describes gallery exhibits, a gallery shop, classes, and arts programs.
cards.source_title: Newark Arts Alliance — Contact
cards.access_notes: Check current gallery hours and whether a particular class or event needs registration.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented University of Delaware rituals, recurring events and campus customs that connect Blue Hens across the academic year.

cards.title: Join the candlelit Blue Hen welcome
cards.subtitle: Central Green • UD Welcome Days
cards.notes: Wear blue and gold, gather on Central Green and take in the formal welcome from UD leadership at this fall-semester candlelight ceremony.
cards.short_summary: A candlelit opening to the Blue Hen community.
cards.evidence_claim: UD describes Twilight Ceremony as a beloved candlelight ceremony on The Green that officially welcomes students with UD leadership.
cards.source_title: Blue Hen Traditions | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Scheduled as part of UD Welcome Days; consult the current Welcome Days program for attendance details.

cards.title: Browse the semester’s organization tables
cards.subtitle: UD campus • fall and spring
cards.notes: Walk the fair with time to ask questions, collect details and identify groups to revisit; UD lists more than 400 clubs and activities.
cards.short_summary: UD’s recurring introduction to campus organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: UD identifies the Involvement Fair as a fall-and-spring opportunity to explore more than 400 clubs, organizations and activities.
cards.source_title: Blue Hen Traditions | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Held each fall and spring; confirm the current location and schedule through Student Life.

cards.title: Learn the game-day repertoire
cards.subtitle: Delaware Stadium • UD Welcome Days
cards.notes: Attend the Welcome Days pep rally and tailgate to learn the fight song, alma mater and game-day customs alongside campus spirit groups.
cards.short_summary: A Welcome Days primer on Blue Hen game traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: UD says Gameday 101 brings incoming students together to learn the fight song, alma mater and other game-day traditions.
cards.source_title: UD Welcome Days | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: A Welcome Days program; current dates and participation information are posted by Orientation & Transition Programs.

cards.title: Wear blue and gold on Friday
cards.subtitle: Campuswide • #BlueHenFridays
cards.notes: Build a simple Friday routine around blue-and-gold clothing, then use the campus hashtag if you want to share your school-spirit photo.
cards.short_summary: A weekly campuswide blue-and-gold ritual.
cards.evidence_claim: UD invites students to show Blue Hen pride by wearing blue and gold every Friday and using #BlueHenFridays.
cards.source_title: Blue Hen Traditions | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Campuswide practice; no registration is indicated on the University traditions page.

cards.title: Follow the fall Homecoming buildup
cards.subtitle: Newark campus • fall semester
cards.notes: Check the current Homecoming calendar for student events and the game-week buildup, then choose an activity that fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: A fall gathering point for students, alumni, families and friends.
cards.evidence_claim: UD states that students, alumni, families and friends celebrate Homecoming each fall through festivities leading to the game.
cards.source_title: Blue Hen Traditions | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Events vary by year; use UD’s current Homecoming listing for individual event requirements.

cards.title: Lean into Geek Week
cards.subtitle: UD campus • recurring program week
cards.notes: Look for the current Geek Week schedule and pick a tournament, speaker, arcade activity or other program that matches your interests.
cards.short_summary: A newer UD tradition celebrating students’ “inner geek.”
cards.evidence_claim: UD calls Geek Week a recent campus tradition featuring activities such as game tournaments, guest speakers and on-campus arcades.
cards.source_title: Blue Hen Traditions | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Programming changes by year; consult the event details linked from Student Life.

cards.title: Watch the Greek Week competitions
cards.subtitle: UD campus • spring semester
cards.notes: Follow the spring schedule for Greek Games, Airband and related philanthropy-focused competitions, and attend only events open to you.
cards.short_summary: A spring competition week tied to fraternity and sorority philanthropy.
cards.evidence_claim: UD describes Greek Week as a spring week of events and competitions among fraternities and sororities supporting philanthropic efforts.
cards.source_title: Blue Hen Traditions | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Participation and attendance vary by program; consult the current fraternity and sorority-life schedule.

cards.title: Mark the last Friday of classes
cards.subtitle: UD campus • end of spring semester
cards.notes: Check the Senior Week calendar, then join the last-Friday-of-classes program for lawn games, inflatables and scheduled entertainment if available.
cards.short_summary: Senior Week’s long-running end-of-classes celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: UD describes Senior Fling as a long-standing event on the last Friday of classes and says all UD students are welcome.
cards.source_title: Blue Hen Traditions | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Occurs during Senior Week; UD says all students are welcome. Check the current program for location and timing.

cards.title: See the five-kiss legend
cards.subtitle: Adjacent to Memorial Hall • The Green
cards.notes: Visit the triple brick arches and treat the marriage promise as campus lore: UD’s archivist says the story is apocryphal, not proven history.
cards.short_summary: A romantic campus legend with a clearly disputed origin.
cards.evidence_claim: UD documents the tradition that five kisses beneath the arches promise marriage, while its archivist says there is no proof and calls it apocryphal.
cards.source_title: The Messenger: UD’s Lore and Legends | UDaily
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark adjacent to Memorial Hall; respect others’ boundaries and the historic setting.

cards.title: Try the Morris Library good-luck rub
cards.subtitle: Hugh M. Morris Library entrance
cards.notes: Find the Hugh M. Morris bust at the library entrance and give its polished nose a respectful rub before an exam—then head inside to study.
cards.short_summary: A library-doorstep superstition for exam-season luck.
cards.evidence_claim: UD identifies rubbing the Hugh Morris bust’s nose for a good grade as a campus legend and notes the nose shows countless student touches.
cards.source_title: The Messenger: UD’s Lore and Legends | UDaily
cards.access_notes: At the entrance to Morris Library; do not climb on or damage the bust.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Delaware, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe loop through central campus: get oriented outdoors, find student hubs, then add a gallery, library, dessert stop, and stadium landmark.

cards.title: Start with a lap around The Green
cards.subtitle: Orientation stop · central campus
cards.notes: Use the brick paths for a daylight orientation walk, noting the surrounding academic buildings before choosing your next campus destination.
cards.short_summary: A simple first pass through UD’s central outdoor landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: UD’s visitor guide invites guests to stroll the brick pathways of The Green with student tour guides.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus area; use normal campus-access and weather precautions.

cards.title: Get your bearings at Trabant
cards.subtitle: 17 West Main Street · student-center stop
cards.notes: Pause at the information desk, refill your water bottle, and use the listed maps and directory to identify dining, lounge, and theater spaces.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street student-center hub with practical amenities and gathering space.
cards.evidence_claim: Trabant has dining, study and gathering spaces, a theater, an information desk, print kiosks, and water-bottle refill stations.
cards.source_title: Trabant University Center | University Student Centers | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: The official page posts seasonal building hours and accessibility information; confirm current hours before going.

cards.title: Take a quiet reset in Daugherty Hall
cards.subtitle: Trabant University Center · second floor
cards.notes: If the building is open, head to room 276 for a brief sit-down, then return to the directory to plan the rest of your walk.
cards.short_summary: A named study-and-gathering room inside Trabant.
cards.evidence_claim: UD describes Daugherty Hall as a tranquil study and gathering space with dramatic arched stained-glass windows.
cards.source_title: Trabant University Center | University Student Centers | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Listed as room 276 in Trabant; access depends on the building’s current operating schedule.

cards.title: Check Perkins for what’s happening
cards.subtitle: 325 Academy Street · campus-center stop
cards.notes: Walk through the first floor, scan the available event information, and make note of meeting rooms, lounges, and student-organization spaces for later.
cards.short_summary: A central multi-use building for dining, events, organizations, and meetings.
cards.evidence_claim: UD identifies Perkins as a campus-center building with dining, daily events, student organizations, and meeting spaces.
cards.source_title: Perkins Student Center | University Student Centers | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: The official page posts seasonal building hours, parking, and ADA-accessibility details; verify hours before visiting.

cards.title: See the Esports Arena setup
cards.subtitle: Perkins Student Center · room 113
cards.notes: Stop by the named arena to see whether campus gaming is in session; use the Student Centers page for the room location and program links.
cards.short_summary: A designated campus gaming venue inside Perkins.
cards.evidence_claim: The Perkins Esports Arena has 38 gaming PCs, a Nintendo Switch console, and streaming broadcast capability.
cards.source_title: Perkins Student Center | University Student Centers | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Listed in Perkins room 113; participation and equipment access may have separate campus rules.

cards.title: Find Memorial Hall on the north end
cards.subtitle: The Green · academic-building landmark
cards.notes: Use the exterior and north steps as a waypoint while walking the Green, then check the university calendar for any open event in the building.
cards.short_summary: A century-old campus landmark with a carillon that plays UD’s alma mater.
cards.evidence_claim: UD reports that Memorial Hall houses the carillon that plays the University’s alma mater.
cards.source_title: Happy 100th, Memorial | UDaily
cards.access_notes: Treat the building as an academic space; enter only when public access or a scheduled event permits.

cards.title: Locate your weekend study fallback
cards.subtitle: 181 S. College Avenue · South Green
cards.notes: Walk to the main entrance, save the library-hours page, and identify the Commons for a future study break after regular library hours.
cards.short_summary: UD’s main library, with a separately identified Commons area.
cards.evidence_claim: Morris Library is at 181 S. College Avenue, and the library identifies the Morris Library Commons as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Hours | UD Library, Museums and Press
cards.access_notes: The Commons is listed as open 24 hours; building and departmental hours vary, so check the live schedule before travel.

cards.title: Check the Old College Gallery calendar
cards.subtitle: Old College Hall · north campus
cards.notes: See whether the rotating exhibition is open during your visit, then take a self-paced look at the gallery before continuing across north campus.
cards.short_summary: One of UD’s campus museum venues for rotating exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: UD Museums lists Old College Gallery among its venues and states that its exhibitions, galleries, and programs are free and open to everyone.
cards.source_title: About University Museums | UD Library, Museums and Press
cards.access_notes: Exhibition availability and gallery hours change; verify the current museums schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Make a daylight UDairy stop
cards.subtitle: 535 S. College Avenue · South Campus
cards.notes: Walk over for a student-made ice cream option, or simply use the flagship location as a South Campus landmark while mapping the athletic complex.
cards.short_summary: A campus creamery store next to the athletic complex and across from UD’s dairy farm.
cards.evidence_claim: UD says the flagship store is at 535 S. College Avenue and that students make ice cream onsite with milk from the farm.
cards.source_title: UDairy Creamery | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: The official page lists daily flagship hours; purchases are optional and current operating details should be checked before going.

cards.title: Finish at Delaware Stadium
cards.subtitle: South Campus · athletic-complex landmark
cards.notes: Walk the public approach to the stadium and nearby athletic buildings, then check the official athletics schedule if you want to plan a future game day.
cards.short_summary: A 22,000-seat campus venue used beyond game days.
cards.evidence_claim: UD describes Delaware Stadium as a 22,000-seat venue used throughout the year, not only on game days.
cards.source_title: Transforming Campus | Alumni & Friends | University of Delaware
cards.access_notes: Outdoor viewing is appropriate; event entry, tickets, and venue access depend on the specific event.
